properties.name: koiki.identity.local-authentication.enabled
properties.description: Enables KOIKI local password authentication. SSO-only applications leave this disabled.

properties.name: koiki.identity.password.maximum-length
properties.description: Maximum accepted local password length in Unicode code points.

properties.name: koiki.identity.login-attempt.account-threshold
properties.description: Consecutive failures before locking a local credential.

properties.name: koiki.identity.login-attempt.account-lock-duration
properties.description: Duration of a local credential lock.

properties.name: koiki.identity.login-attempt.source-protection
properties.description: Places source protection in the application or an approved external ingress.

properties.name: koiki.identity.login-attempt.source-threshold
properties.description: Failures before blocking a source fingerprint.

properties.name: koiki.identity.login-attempt.retention
properties.description: Retention target for expired attempt rows.

properties.name: koiki.identity.login-attempt.source-hmac-key-id
properties.description: Identifier of the deployment HMAC key; required for APPLICATION source protection.

properties.name: koiki.identity.login-attempt.source-hmac-key
properties.description: Base64 deployment secret of at least 32 bytes; required for APPLICATION source protection.

values.description: KOIKI applies HMAC-based source attempt protection.
An approved public ingress applies equivalent source protection.
